slot.subtopic: Cross product and angle between vectors
slot.brief: compute the cross product of two given vectors, then use it to find the sine of the angle between them (or the area of the triangle they span)

stem: The area of the triangle whose two adjacent sides are represented by the vectors a = 2i - j + k and b = i + j - 2k is

verdicts.working: The area is \(\frac12|\mathbf a\times\mathbf b|\). Here \(\mathbf a\times\mathbf b=(1,5,3)\), so the area is \(\sqrt{35}/2\).

working:
a cross b = i + 5j + 3k. Its magnitude is sqrt(1^2 + 5^2 + 3^2) = sqrt(35). Area of the triangle = (1/2) * magnitude = sqrt(35)/2.

Independent check: The area is \(\frac12|\mathbf a\times\mathbf b|\). Here \(\mathbf a\times\mathbf b=(1,5,3)\), so the area is \(\sqrt{35}/2\).
solution: The area of the triangle is $\frac12|\mathbf a\times\mathbf b|$.\n$$\mathbf a\times\mathbf b=\mathbf i+5\mathbf j+3\mathbf k,\qquad |\mathbf a\times\mathbf b|=\sqrt{1+25+9}=\sqrt{35}$$\nHence, the area is $\boxed{\frac{\sqrt{35}}{2}}$.
